---
title: Add New Leads
description: >-
  Input new lead profiles by capturing business names, selecting industry types,
  identifying operational challenges, and saving them to the central database.
---
**Lead:&#xA0;**&#x70;otential members who have shown interest but haven't fully joined the loyalty program yet.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1378" height="761" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Members > Lead Details. Click the Add Content button to manually input new lead information.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="249" height="296" style="width: 249px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="378" height="155" style="width: 378px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Capture key business information such as the business name, industry type, and the number of physical locations.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="611" height="273" style="width: 611px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Click the Submit button at the bottom of the page to save the lead's profile into the central database.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="620" height="327" style="width: 620px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
